# Agent Data Tools x402 — Full Agent Reference

Canonical origin: https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app
Protocol: x402 v2
Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453)
Asset: Base USDC
Payment recipient: 0x708f7b52b56eafd7fc1de65fc7752ed732914021

## Portfolio

### Pennsylvania best match — $0.001
GET /_api/pa-entity-one?q=NAME
Returns one highest-ranked Pennsylvania legal-entity record.

### Pennsylvania enriched search — $0.005
GET /_api/pa-business?q=NAME&limit=N
Returns up to 25 ranked Pennsylvania registry candidates with source-published principal/officer enrichment.

### Pennsylvania vendor-intake decision gate — $0.020
GET /_api/vendor-intake-gate?name=NAME&address=ADDRESS&domain=DOMAIN
Returns proceed or human_review with explicit review triggers and evidence from PA registry identity, Census address consistency, OFAC candidate-name screening, and authoritative RDAP domain data.

### SEC Recent Filings — $0.005
GET /_api/sec-filings?ticker=TICKER&form=FORM&limit=N
Or supply cik instead of ticker. Returns authoritative recent EDGAR filing identifiers, dates, accession numbers, and direct filing URLs.

### U.S. Census Address Geocoder — $0.005
GET /_api/us-address-geocode?address=ADDRESS
Returns standardized Census address match, coordinates, and available geography identifiers.

### OFAC SDN Name Screen — $0.005
GET /_api/ofac-sdn-screen?name=NAME&limit=N&minScore=SCORE
Returns ranked review candidates from current SDN primary names and aliases. A no-candidate result is not sanctions clearance and the service does not perform OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis.

### Domain RDAP Lookup — $0.005
GET /_api/domain-rdap?domain=DOMAIN
Uses IANA RDAP bootstrap to locate the authoritative registry and returns current public registration metadata.

### Treasury Average Interest Rates — $0.005
GET /_api/treasury-average-rates?security=FILTER
Returns the latest monthly average interest rates on outstanding U.S. Treasury securities from Fiscal Data. These are not live market yields.

## Payment contract

All paid routes use x402 v2 on Base USDC.

Unpaid:
- challenge is returned before arbitrary source work
- PAYMENT-REQUIRED advertises exact amount/network/asset/payTo

Paid attempt:
1. decode payment authorization
2. validate request input
3. verify authorization
4. fetch authoritative source data / produce decision
5. settle only after a usable result exists

Authoritative-source failure:
- no settlement
- upstream error returned

Verifier or settlement uncertainty:
- retrySamePayment semantics
- no fresh payment challenge for settlement_pending / duplicate / indeterminate states
- retry the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE

Success:
- PAYMENT-RESPONSE
- x402-settled:true
- paid:true

## Vendor-gate fail-closed rules

Automatic continuation requires exactly one strong PA legal-entity match with complete core identity evidence.

Submitted and registry Census responses must satisfy their evidence contract. The normalized primary street number and ZIP must match and coordinate distance must remain within the configured threshold.

OFAC evidence must satisfy the configured query/threshold/count/source contract. Any candidate at or above the review threshold triggers human review.

RDAP evidence must match the requested domain, include a boolean registration result, identify an authoritative RDAP endpoint and source, confirm registration, and plausibly align the hostname with the vendor name.

Proceed is only a workflow signal. It is not legal/compliance approval, sanctions clearance, fraud or credit approval, proof of good standing, or proof of address/domain ownership.

## Authoritative public sources

- Pennsylvania Department of State public business data via data.pa.gov
- U.S. Census Bureau Geocoding Services
- U.S. Treasury OFAC Sanctions List Service
- IANA RDAP bootstrap and authoritative registry RDAP servers
- U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR
- U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data
